title: Output of Career Site Jobs Scraper
description: One row per job in the default dataset; a per-company run summary in the OUTPUT record. Companies with no jobs get a free status row with a reason.

results.title: Jobs
results.description: One row per job. Example: {"companyName":"Stripe","title":"Backend Engineer, Payments","location":"Seattle, WA","remote":false,"salaryMin":180000,"salaryMax":250000,"salaryCurrency":"USD","postedAt":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","ats":"greenhouse","jobUrl":"https://…"}. Status rows: {"status":"no_results","input":"stripe","jobsFound":120,"jobsMatched":0,"reason":"…"}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: companies (ATS used, jobsFound, jobsSaved, status), jobsSaved, maxJobs, stoppedReason and zeroResultsReason.
